liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Jack Straw into Sugaree and the Deal their favorite versions ever; Reviewer finds Jack Straw focused but not rock-star level, followed by a casual segue into an easy-going Sugaree [19][23]
- **Lazy Lightnin'** (2 reviews): A fan in the crowd repeatedly shouted for Lazy Lightning, and the band then started it, as if answering; Lazy Lightning into Supplication is described as very tight [17][21]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Reviewer wonders whether Cassidy as the third song was unusual in 1982 [23]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Deal top notch and the China-Rider quite good [27]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat into Rider, running through Not Fade Away in set two, is called inspiring [19]
- **Never Trust A Woman** (1 review): Brent's Good Times Blues is called the reviewer's favorite version, soulful, with reverb on his vocal mic [21]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Not Fade Away jam has flurries of angry playing by Garcia, rivaling the reviewer's favorite from 11/8/79 [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-05-22.mtx.seamons.101450.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1982-05-22.sbd.miller.96331.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd1982-05-22.163529.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 168 min [4]
- **gd82-05-22.sbd.gorinsky.5215.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 157 min; rated 4.33/5 by 33 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording excellent quality; they got the tape around 1983; Phil is very clear in the mix on this soundboard [21][27]
- **gd1982-05-22.152509.aud-unknown-complete-onemoreshot.flacf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 159 min [11]. Said about its sound: Uploader considers this one of the best audience recordings in the world [11]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes few photos exist of the tie-dye crowd from 1982, unlike the following year, which had wild colored sheets [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-05-22.mtx.seamons.101450.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC) [1]. Also: Soundboard to Sony TC-D5M cassette master, then DAT, then CD, then FLAC; transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller; Cassette played on a Nakamichi Dragon with Dolby B decoding, into a Panasonic SV 3700 DAT at 44.1 [1]
- **gd1982-05-22.sbd.miller.96331.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD [3]. Also: Front-of-board audience source with unknown mics, taken from a CD; the only circulating source without digital noise reduction [3]
- **gd1982-05-22.163529.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Wiseman and Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [4]. Also: A Nakamichi 300 source by N. Hoey supplies patches in Cumberland Blues, He's Gone and the Wharf Rat to Around & Around transition [4]
- **gd82-05-22.sbd.gorinsky.5215.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [10]
- **gd1982-05-22.152509.aud-unknown-complete-onemoreshot.flacf**: source: Unknown FOB Audience source > ? > CD > EAC > FLAC [11]. Also: Unknown-source complete audience recording; an earlier torrent was missing set one and duplicated the first half of set two [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, The Greek Theater, Berkeley, CA. Three shows May 1982 (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/01/grateful-dead-greek-theater-berkeley-ca.html) [30]
- Poster by Daniel Ziegler: [Grateful Dead Greek Theatre Berkeley 1982 Concert Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/730262/Grateful-Dead-Greek-Theatre-Berkeley-1982-Concert-Poster) [34]
